notes.title: Update 1.1 Major Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here is an important update for my game.

- Net code optimization
- New character to play
- Added a outline on the balloons to see the progress of other players
- Added a outline on the players in the maze to see other players progress
- Added a new cartoon post effect.

notes.title: Update 0.17
notes.content:
Update 0.17 available

- Fixed all the fx sound not attached to the sound settings

- Fixed the AI damage not detected by turret missiles

- Added a visual effect trajectory for the grenades

notes.title: Ragdoll Party Online - Early Access Begins!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=FDFcGFxEq40;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Create your own level with your friends online in the sandbox mode, play the mini-games, ragdoll, drive a car, fly with a Jetpack, fart to go higher, throw grenades. Access more than 45 items to build your own level.


[h2]Hot Deal[/h2]
During the first week early adopters will get a 10% discount on the Early Access price of $9,99.

notes.title: Update 0.16

Update 0.16 Available

- A brand new Mini Game - The maze -

Have Fun :)

notes.title: Update 0.14

notes.title: UPDATE 0.13
notes.content:
Today Update 0.13

I added a new mini-game called Soccer Ball. You have to push the giant soccer ball through the level, you can push it and throw grenade at it :)

Have Fun!

notes.title: Update 0.11
notes.content:

I added a new mini-game called jump pad. You have to jump on the pads to cross large walls and avoid traps.

Have Fun!
